text.source: Results: NYC Board of Elections unofficial election-night results (enr.boenyc.gov, as of 12:42 a.m. EST Nov 4, 2026; scanners reporting by district range from about 81% to 99%), summed by City Council district (each election district is assigned to the council district that contains it). Hochul includes the Democratic and Working Families lines; Blakeman includes the Republican, Conservative and Vote Affordable lines; write-ins are left out. Hexagon weight is votes cast for the two candidates, not residents, because council districts are drawn at near-equal population. Council district lines: NYC Department of City Planning, districts in force for the 2023 election, clipped to the shoreline. Election districts: NYC 2020 election district boundaries.
